fields.title: Window definition
fields.description: Defines the position of the current row (or current point of time) relative to the window.

fields.title: Trigger
fields.description: Select whether the window and step sizes are defined in terms of number of rows (Row based) or a date/time interval (Time based).

fields.title: Window size (rows)
fields.description: The number of rows contained in each window. With each iteration, the node returns a table with this many rows (or fewer at the boundaries when limiting to the table).

fields.title: Step size (rows)
fields.description: The distance (in number of rows) between the starting point of one iteration and the starting point of the next.

fields.title: Time column
fields.description: Select the input-column used for time-based windowingChoose a column containing tempora values such as Date, Time, Date&time,or Date&time with zone.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Window size (time)
fields.description: The date/time interval covered by each window. When a unit is selected, enter an integer; when "Duration string" is selected, enter a duration or period string (e.g. PT1H30M for 1.5 hours, or P1M for 1 month).

fields.title: Window size unit
fields.description: The unit for the window size. Select "Duration string" to provide a full ISO-8601 duration/period string in the window size field.

fields.title: Step size (time)
fields.description: The date/time interval between the starting point of one iteration and the starting point of the next. When a unit is selected, enter an integer; when "Duration string" is selected, enter a duration or period string.

fields.title: Step size unit
fields.description: The unit for the step size. Select "Duration string" to provide a full ISO-8601 duration/period string in the step size field.

fields.title: Use specific start time
fields.description: If selected, the windowing starts at the specified date and time. If not selected, the windowing starts with the date and time of the first row in the table.

fields.title: Start time
fields.description: The time at which the windowing should start, inclusive. Shown when the selected time column is of type "Time".

fields.title: Start date
fields.description: The date at which the windowing should start, inclusive. Shown when the selected time column is of type "Date".

fields.title: Start date&time
fields.description: The local date&time at which the windowing should start, inclusive. Shown when the selected time column is of type "Date&time".

fields.title: Start date&time with zone
fields.description: The zoned date&time at which the windowing should start, inclusive. Shown when the selected time column is of type "Date&time with zone".

fields.title: Limit window to table
fields.description: If selected, the window will be moved using the defined step size in such a way that it will not extend beyond the beginning of the table (if Backward or Central is selected) or beyond the end of the table (if Forward or Central is selected). Note: rows at the start and end may be omitted. If not selected, rows with missing values may be added to guarantee a static window size.
